episodes.title: La noche de las sirenas
episodes.summary: On a tense night in Madrid, as Spanish and French hooligans face off, an ambulance driver reels from seeing his daughter among the violent crowd.

episodes.title: Sentimientos encontrados
episodes.summary: At the funeral, a bereft Salvador is caught off guard, drawing unwanted attention. As the police investigation stalls, he looks for answers elsewhere.

episodes.title: ‘Quid pro quo’
episodes.summary: As Salvador's perspective starts to shift and Julia edges closer to Nacho, the White Souls need someone to take the fall for the Molotov cocktail.

episodes.title: Minuto de silencio
episodes.summary: A heated incident on the job pulls Salvador and Marjane apart. The White Souls pay homage to Milena as they prepare to wreak havoc in Marseille.

episodes.title: Cantos de sirena
episodes.summary: When footage from the airport makes headlines, Salvador hits another low point. Disgusted by a new narrative being peddled, Martín doesn't hold back.

episodes.title: La cena
episodes.summary: Hoping to move on, Salvador lays Milena to rest. But as violent footage of her murder goes viral, he attends an explosive dinner in the lion's den.

episodes.title: ‘Incel’
episodes.summary: As Milena's killer becomes known to a select few, Martín, Carla and Julia face uncomfortable truths while others race to control the story.

episodes.title: Un padre
episodes.summary: With Nacho and Tibu hot on their tail, Salvador and Marjane race to save a patient in need. As the house of cards collapses, past loyalties dissolve.
